parsed.rationale: Both members are unnamed extensions on (presumably) `UserDefaults` within the same `Caching` package — one in `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` at line 15 and one embedded in `DefaultsStorage.swift` at line 47. Having two extension declarations on the same type scattered across two files in the same package creates a name-collision signal and makes it harder to reason about the full surface area of the `UserDefaults` extension. Consolidating both into the dedicated `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` file (the file whose name already signals its purpose) eliminates the split and gives a single authoritative location for all WXYC-specific `UserDefaults` additions inside the `Caching` package.
